input.goal: Pulse all the dressing ingredients in a food processor until mostly smooth.

sub_goals.text: Test the blender and prepare the avocado
Weigh and add the avocado to the canister
Retrieve and add greek yoghurt to the canister
Add water and parsley to the canister
Prepare and add garlic to the canister
Add salt and blend the dressing ingredients

skills.object_recognition: L1: which object is in hand / being handled at the moment of the event
skills.action_recognition: L2: what action (verb + object) the event is
skills.event_object_role: L2: which object is acted on, with which tool, to which destination in the event
skills.action_temporal_order: L2: the order of two actions shown close together inside one sub-goal
skills.sound_action_binding: L2: which action / object produced the sound heard
skills.sound_movement_binding: L2: which object movement coincides with the sound
skills.spatial_near: L1: at the moment of the event, which of the listed objects is nearest to a reference object (3D positions from the dataset)
skills.spatial_side: L1: at the moment of the event, which listed object is leftmost / rightmost from the wearer's viewpoint
skills.sound_anchored_spatial_near: L2: at the moment of a sound, which listed object is nearest to a reference object
skills.sound_anchored_spatial_side: L2: at the moment of a sound, which listed object is leftmost / rightmost for the wearer
skills.object_location_at_time: L1: on which surface / fixture / container an object is put down at the event
skills.object_state_change: L2: where an object was taken from and where it went in one movement

l3_relation_types.object_continuity: the same object / ingredient appears in an event of sub-goal k and an event of the ADJACENT sub-goal k+1; what happened to it between them (chopped broccoli -> in the pan)
l3_relation_types.state_change: how the state of an object differs between the two events (whole -> chopped, empty -> full, raw -> browned)
l3_relation_types.causal_prerequisite: the earlier event is a physical prerequisite of the later one (could not be done without it)
l3_relation_types.hidden_state: an appliance / container state was set in the earlier event and is not visible in the later segment; what is its state at the end of the later segment

plan.goal: Pulse all the dressing ingredients in a food processor until mostly smooth.

events.description: The blender motor runs briefly as it is tested.
events.relevance: ensures the equipment is working before adding ingredients

events.description: The person cuts the avocado in half with a knife.
events.relevance: opens the avocado to access the flesh

events.description: The person removes the pit from the avocado half.
events.relevance: discards the inedible part of the avocado

events.description: The person places the blender canister onto the kitchen scale.
events.relevance: prepares the canister to measure the incoming ingredients by weight

events.description: The person scoops the avocado flesh into the canister using a spoon.
events.relevance: adds the first main ingredient to the blender

events.description: The person spoons greek yoghurt from its container into the canister.
events.relevance: adds the creamy base for the dressing

events.description: The person pours water into the canister.
The person puts fresh parsley into the canister.
events.relevance: adds herbs for flavor and color

events.description: The person peels and crushes the garlic clove on the cutting board.
events.relevance: prepares the garlic to be blended

events.description: The person drops the prepared garlic into the canister.
events.relevance: adds the aromatic ingredient to the mix

events.description: The person sprinkles salt into the canister.
The person places the lid securely onto the canister.
events.relevance: seals the blender so ingredients do not spill out

events.description: The blender motor runs loudly, pulsing the ingredients together.
events.relevance: processes the ingredients into a smooth dressing

relations.ask: What allowed the person to scoop the avocado flesh into the canister?
relations.answer_hint: The avocado was cut open in the previous step.

relations.ask: What is the canister resting on while the yoghurt is being added?
relations.answer_hint: The canister was placed on the kitchen scale in the previous step.

relations.ask: What white ingredient is already inside the canister when the water is poured?
relations.answer_hint: Greek yoghurt was added in the previous step.

relations.ask: What green leafy ingredient is visible in the canister when the garlic is dropped in?
relations.answer_hint: Parsley was added in the previous step.

relations.ask: Why is the mixture ready to be blended at this point?
relations.answer_hint: The final solid ingredient, garlic, was added in the previous step.

decision_points.why: After preparing the avocado, deciding to weigh it and add it to the canister is a distinct next step in the recipe sequence.
Moving from the avocado to retrieving and adding the next specific ingredient (yoghurt) requires a choice of what to add next.
Selecting water and parsley as the next ingredients to add is a deliberate progression in building the dressing.
Switching from adding ready ingredients to preparing a new raw ingredient (garlic) is a distinct task transition.
Deciding that all main ingredients are in, adding the final seasoning, and initiating the blending process is a major state transition.
Deciding that the dressing has reached the 'mostly smooth' consistency and stopping the blender concludes the task.
